content.learning_goal: Enable Grade 7 learners to understand and apply the central ideas of Connecting the Dots….

explanation_sections.title: Activate
explanation_sections.explanation: Connect the chapter to prior knowledge, observation or experience.

explanation_sections.title: Build
explanation_sections.explanation: Teach from the source-grounded points and examples.
source_evidence: 5 CONNECTING THE DOTS… 5.1 Of Questions and Statements Your teacher tells you that they are meeting two of their childhood friends this evening.
What is your guess as to each friend’s gender based on this information?
You might have guessed that the 5-foot-tall person is a woman and the 6-foot-tall person is a man.
But experience tells us that 5-foot-tall men and 6-foot-tall women are rare.
We regularly come across statements like — Jemimah’s batting has I take about been very consistent over 15 minutes the past year.

explanation_sections.title: Reason
explanation_sections.explanation: Ask learners to explain relationships, evidence, patterns or steps.

explanation_sections.title: Transfer
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from the textbook context to a closely related new situation.

misconceptions: Confusing an example with the underlying concept.
checks_for_understanding: What changes if an important condition changes?
content.closure: Learner states the central idea, supporting evidence and one application.
